page: Vultr vc2-2c-4gb is a shared-CPU instance belonging to the Cloud Compute family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and is bundled with 80 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include any GPU resources but provides one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests scored 1226.09 and 2501.8 respectively, both falling into the bottom 25% performance category. Memory bandwidth is limited, with large-block read-only operations reaching 19.26 GB/sec and write operations at 16.87 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and memory scores are also in the bottom 10%, reflecting the shared nature of the CPU resources.

Database and application-level benchmarks show similar entry-level characteristics. Redis SET operations achieved 1.36 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reached 1.8 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning, prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model registered 119.57 tokens per second. Given these metrics, the instance offers a cost-effective entry point for low-traffic web serving, basic development environments, lightweight background tasks, and small utility databases where dedicated CPU performance is not required.
